title: netwatch doctor --json, schema_version 1
description: A capability snapshot, which describes what this host lets netwatch see. It says nothing about network health. Later minors may add fields, so ignore any you do not know. A break needs netwatch 2.0 and a new schema file. A field marked deprecated tells you nothing useful, so do not rely on it. It goes only in a major version. This file describes what netwatch 0.40 and later write; 0.39 has no metadata block.

metadata.description: Names this output's schema. Every stable netwatch output has this block, at the same path.

netwatch_version.description: The netwatch that wrote this document.

scope.description: What the snapshot had the chance to check. static is a plain doctor run, capture_check is one with --check-capture, and runtime is a live session's own view, which no command prints today. Open set: a minor may add a scope, so treat an unknown value like static and read each capability's state.

platform.description: Rust's name for the operating system. Open set: a build for a new platform adds a value.

interface.description: The capture interface asked for or selected. Null when none is configured or chosen.

protections.description: One entry per component that took a sandbox policy. Empty from a plain doctor run, and holds at most the isolated check from --check-capture.

network_restricted.description: Always false, because it describes the whole process and main and the network workers keep the network. It carries no information. Read each protection's network_policy instead. Do not rely on it. It goes only in a major version.

attribution_coverage.description: Null from netwatch doctor. Only a live session has coverage to report.

landlock.description: What this kernel has and what a parser thread gets. Null off Linux.

tasks_holding_net_raw.description: Threads holding CAP_NET_RAW when a session audited itself at startup. Null from netwatch doctor, which starts no session, and off Linux.

id.description: Which capability this is. Not every id appears on every platform or scope. Open set: a minor may add an id, so ignore one you do not know.

state.description: Closed set: a new value needs netwatch 2.0. This is the field to enforce a requirement on, so a script can list every value. ready describes a checked capability, not network health.

reason.description: A machine-readable code for why the capability is in this state. An existing code keeps its meaning. Open set: a minor may add a code, so read state for the verdict and treat an unknown code as more detail.

detail.description: Explanation in words. The wording is not stable.

next_check.description: What to do or run next, in words. The wording is not stable.

component.description: The thread or worker this is about, such as capture-check.

effective.description: The sandbox mode in force. Null when the component has no report. Open set: a minor may add a mode, so treat an unknown value as not strict.

landlock_abi.description: The Landlock ABI of what this thread enforces: the newest feature in force, so 3 for the filesystem layer alone on any newer kernel.

warnings.description: In words. The wording is not stable.

error.description: In words. The wording is not stable.

network_policy.description: denied when this thread's TCP bind and connect are denied, allowed when it entered a policy and they are not, not_entered when it has no report. Open set: a minor may add a value, so treat anything but denied as not shown to be denied.

landlock_restrictions.description: What this thread's policy restricts. socket_create comes from the seccomp filter, the rest from Landlock.

items.description: Open set: a new kernel feature adds a value.

capture_authority.description: CAP_NET_RAW on this thread. Open set: a minor may add a value, so treat anything but dropped or not_held as still holding it.

socket_filter.description: The no-socket seccomp filter. Open set: a minor may add a value, so treat anything but installed as not filtered.

kernel_abi.description: The ABI the kernel reports, 0 without Landlock.

availability.description: not_built also covers a seccomp profile blocking the syscalls. Open set: a minor may add a value, so treat anything but available as unavailable.

errata.description: The errata the kernel reports fixed, by the numbers in the kernel's documentation.

parser_check.description: What a parser thread got when it tried TCP under its policy. Null if the check did not complete.

enforced_abi.description: The same meaning as a protection's landlock_abi.

items.description: Open set: a new kernel feature adds a value.

tcp_bind.description: error is anything else a check got back. Open set: a minor may add a value, so treat anything but denied as not denied.

tcp_connect.description: error is anything else a check got back. Open set: a minor may add a value, so treat anything but denied as not denied.

table_source.description: Linux: the table the latest poll read. Null before the first poll, when no table could be read, and on other platforms. Open set: a minor may add a source.

table_note.description: Why the latest poll did not read ss, in words. The wording is not stable.
